messages.subject: probability density
parts:
Hello,

I am using unmarked to calculate occupancy probability.

I then want to calculate a defaunation index but want to incorporate the uncertainty from the occupancy estimate into this calculation. I want to do it by taking random draws from a probability distribution, but I don't know how to obtain a probability distribution (or density, whichever you prefer to call it) from the occu function in unmarked. I could write the occupancy models in JAGS and then take the posterior distribution from that, but it would be easier and faster if I could use unmarked. I thought I might be able to do this with parboot() but haven't been able to figure it out yet. 

Anyone know how to do this?

Thanks
- Jesse
